data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 – refund of €767
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielhausen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 on 27 October 2025. Tax set at €7,012.00, and after withheld wage tax you get a refund of €767.00.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment for 2024. Withheld wage tax (€7,779) was higher than the tax due (€7,012), so you get €767 back, to be paid into your known bank account in the next few days. Check that the figures match your tax return. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically; the app shows until when. If you don't object, the assessment becomes final. A tax adviser can help if unsure.
data.tax_note: This is the income tax assessment for 2024; keep it with your tax records.
